name: Selma
source:
A treasure hunter who targets the hidden bounties of the world's labyrinths.

She's usually easy-going, but her eyes light up and excitement builds when she's faced with new discoveries and treasure.

With her approachable personality, she hits it off with Edgar who she sees as a friend. Although the allure of gold is a strong one, she pursues the romance of discovering unknown treasures and the truth behind legends.

She's now after the treasure reputedly located in the temple of the ancients in the depths of the underground labyrinth.

[Spoiler] The daughter of the famous treasure hunter, Vint, Selma took up after her father after hearing many stories of his adventures on his infrequent visits to home. When Vint disappeared in the hunt for the mythical Kohaku insect, she set off to find him and ended up in Dantor. Edgar and Lusit first meet her when they are looking to sell their loot from dungeon exploration and she stops them from being cheated by unscrupulous roadside vendors.

Selma, together with Edgar and fellow guild members, eventually find live specimens of the Kohaku insect but fail to capture a sample. During this time Selma discovers her father was recently in Dantor and is possibly still alive in the dungeons searching for the insect. 

Flirtatious and outgoing, Selma has no qualms using sex to get her way. Although her ambition is to make a name for herself worldwide as a treasure hunter, Dantor has too much of a hold over her at the present. Until she finds her father and possibly a live specimen of the Kohaku insect, she cannot pursue her dream of wandering the world as her father did in search for romance and treasure. [/Spoiler]
